responsibility: This file implements the lto-dump executable, an inspection front end for GCC LTO object files. After initializing the shared LTO reader and loading symbol/callgraph data, it provides user-facing dump actions for listing functions and variables, printing symbol details or GIMPLE bodies, emitting the symtab callgraph in Graphviz form, and reporting tree/GIMPLE statistics, all driven by the LTODump options defined for this tool.
